headlines.title: 쪽방촌 찾은 구윤철 부총리 "폭염 취약계층 에 관심· 지원 지속할 것"

headlines.title: " 실거주 예외 최장 3년 …민의 반영해 보완검토"
headlines.summary: 구윤철 부총리 밝혀 정부가 장기거주소득공제를 도입하는 가운데 비거주 1주택자의 실거주 예외 인정과 관련한 제도를 재검토할 계획이다. 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관(사진)은 7일 MBC 라디오 인터뷰에서 "국회 논의 단계 등을 통해 국민 의견을 충분히 경청하겠다"며 "합리적인 범위 내에서는 얼마든지 의견을 반영할 것"이라고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 강남 16억 낮춘 급매 … 한강벨트는 올라
headlines.summary: 부동산 세제개편發 시장재편 "세금 오르기 전 빨리 팔자" 초고가 아파트 등 매물 늘어 마용성 아파트 가격 방어…李, 공급대책 최종점검 나서 정부가 8·3 세제개편안을 발표한 이후 서울 강남 초고가 단지에서 호가를 크게 낮춘 급매물이 나오기 시작했다. 실거주를 하더라도 보유세·양도세 부담이 커진 초고가 주택 소유자들이 절세를 위해 매도에 나선 것이다.

headlines.title: '공급 속도전' 위해 부동산 금융 규제 푼다
headlines.summary: 李 "주택공급 과감히 실천하라" 6시간 난상 토론 PF보증 확대 등 금융 지원 논의 이주비 대출규제 완화도 추진 "용산 부지, 서울시와 협의하라" 한성숙·구윤철·김용범 등 참석 이재명 대통령은 7일 '제3기 진실·화해를 위한 과거사정리위원회' 출범을 계기로 국가 폭력 피해자들을 청와대에 초청해 위로 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령이 인사말을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 토허구역 실수요자 대출 규제 완화 검토
headlines.summary: 청년·신혼부부·갈아타기 등 대상 매수 자금 문턱 낮추는 핀셋 지원 연합뉴스 정부가 토지거래허가구역 안에서 무주택 청년과 신혼부부 등 실수요자를 대상으로 대출 규제를 일부 완화하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 토허구역과 대출 규제가 겹치면서 투기 수요자뿐 아니라 실수요자도 자금 조달에 어려움을 겪는 부작용을 줄이려는 취지다.

headlines.title: 누가 웃고 누가 더 낼까… 세제 개편, 달라진 부동산 셈법

headlines.title: 美 “ 폴리실리콘 쓴 제품 15% 관세 ” 中저가공세 차단

top5_headlines.summary: 중국산 폴리실리콘 제재 목적 무역확장법 조사 결과 공개 임박 美서 제품 만드는 기업 영향 주목 韓정부 "유연 적용해달라" 요청 【파이낸셜뉴스 서울·뉴욕=박종원 기자 이병철 특파원】 지난해부터 중국을 겨냥해 폴리실리콘 추가 관세를 추진했던 미국 도널드 트럼프 정부가 이르면 6일(현지시간) 결과를 발표할 예정이다.

top5_headlines.title: '공급 속도전' 위해 부동산 금융 규제 푼다
top5_headlines.summary: 李 "주택공급 과감히 실천하라" 6시간 난상 토론 PF보증 확대 등 금융 지원 논의 이주비 대출규제 완화도 추진 "용산 부지, 서울시와 협의하라" 한성숙·구윤철·김용범 등 참석 이재명 대통령은 7일 '제3기 진실·화해를 위한 과거사정리위원회' 출범을 계기로 국가 폭력 피해자들을 청와대에 초청해 위로 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령이 인사말을 하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: “ 비거주 1주택 예외인정 , 3년 보다 더 늘릴 수도”
top5_headlines.summary: ■ 구윤철, 실거주 규제 완화 시사 “국민 의견 듣고 신축적으로 검토” 같은 시군 내 이동 인정 여부 관건 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 지난 6일 오전 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 비상경제본부 회의 겸 경제ㆍ구조혁신 관계장관회의에서 발언하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 美 “ 폴리실리콘 쓴 제품 15% 관세 ” 中저가공세 차단
top5_headlines.summary: 미국내 태양광 생산거점 확대 노려 韓 한화-OCI 등 반사이익 가능성 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령. 워싱턴=AP/뉴시스 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 6일(현지 시간) 반도체와 태양광의 핵심 재료인 웨이퍼 등 폴리실리콘 파생제품에 15% 관세를 부과한다는 포고령을 발표했다. 중국의 저가 공세를 막고 미국 내 태양광 생산 거점을 확대하기 위한 조치다.

key_headlines.title: US Imposes 15% Tariff on Polysilicon Products to Block Chinese Competition
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration announced a 15% tariff on polysilicon-derived products used in semiconductors and solar panels, targeting Chinese low-cost competition. Korean companies like Hanwha and OCI may benefit from expanded US domestic solar production opportunities.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Eases Real Estate Finance Regulations to Accelerate Housing Supply
key_headlines.summary: President Lee announced measures to relax property finance regulations including expanded PF guarantees and reduced relocation loan restrictions. The government aims to boost housing supply through aggressive policy implementation.

key_headlines.title: US Employment Drops 23,000 in July Amid Mixed Economic Signals
key_headlines.summary: July employment unexpectedly declined by 23,000 while unemployment fell to 4.1%, creating mixed signals for Federal Reserve policy. Markets now price in a 60% probability of interest rate hold at the September FOMC meeting, up from 45%.

key_headlines.title: Property Tax Overhaul Creates Vastly Different Tax Burdens Based on Residency Status
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's real estate tax reform applies different tax rates to identical properties depending on owner residency and number of properties owned. Non-resident single-property owners may receive extended exemptions beyond the current 3-year period.

key_headlines.title: SK Hynix Invests 54 Trillion Won in AI Memory Capacity Expansion
key_headlines.summary: SK Hynix announced major investments in new fabrication plants in Yongin and Cheongju to meet growing AI-driven memory demand. The company aims to expand both DRAM and NAND production infrastructure for long-term growth.

sections.Hot Economy News: The US announced 15% tariffs on polysilicon and related semiconductor and solar panel materials, targeting Chinese competition and aiming to expand domestic US production. South Korea's government announced significant real estate finance deregulation to accelerate housing supply, including expanded PF guarantees and reduced relocation loan restrictions. Meanwhile, Korean property tax reforms are creating vastly different tax burdens for identical properties based on residency status and ownership count. The government is also pushing economic structural innovation across multiple sectors including robotics, semiconductors, batteries, and shipbuilding.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: US employment unexpectedly declined by 23,000 in July while unemployment fell to 4.1%, creating mixed economic signals. Bond markets reacted strongly with 2-year Treasury yields falling and the probability of a September Fed rate hold increasing to 60% from 45%. South Korea's July consumer inflation fell to the 2% range for the first time in three months, but core inflation remains elevated, keeping the Bank of Korea cautious about future rate decisions. The upcoming US CPI and PPI reports on August 12-13 will be critical for determining the September FOMC decision.
sections.Financial Markets: US stock markets surged on weak employment data, with the S&P 500 reaching all-time highs and Nasdaq rising 1.3%, as investors welcomed reduced interest rate hike prospects. KOSPI experienced significant volatility, dropping over 4% with intraday losses exceeding 5%, triggering program trading halts, while KOSDAQ fell below the 800 level. The Korean won strengthened unexpectedly against the dollar despite KOSPI weakness, declining over 120 won to the 1,430 range as AI investment boom reverses traditional currency patterns. Deposit inflows reached 35.5 trillion won as investors seek safety, though deposit interest rates have fallen below expected levels despite recent rate hikes.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's government launched an economic structural innovation drive with Samsung establishing a new robotics business division. Battery companies including LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI, and SK On are advancing thermal runaway prevention technologies in response to record heatwaves affecting EV adoption. A domestically developed AI semiconductor capable of adapting its response characteristics to input data speed changes has been created, potentially reducing prediction errors by up to 40%. Industry experts suggest semiconductor declines have stabilized and expect August recovery driven by AI chip demand and strong electricity/shipbuilding sector performance.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul faces housing supply challenges as apartment construction volumes fell from 40,000 units average annually to 27,000 in 2023 and 22,000 in 2024. Seoul City Mayor Oh Se-hoon released a report to the presidential office blaming past massive deregulation of redevelopment zones and proposing private redevelopment projects as the key solution. Property market polarization by region continues despite overall price increases, with recent transactions involving fraudulent sales contracts. Next week, 4,808 housing units will be launched for sale including Gimpo's Hangang Puregio Riverfront and other projects.
sections.International Economy: Trump administration is attempting to remove Federal Reserve Governor Cook, reviving mortgage fraud allegations amid tensions between the president and the Fed over interest rate policy. The US is implementing a 'pressure first, negotiate later' strategy with China ahead of planned Xi-Trump talks on August 24, using polysilicon tariffs as leverage. South Korea, Japan, and EU member countries were spared from the full tariff impact, suggesting strategic trade relationship management. Whirlpool's struggling US manufacturing operations are cited by Chinese media as evidence of the limitations of American protectionist policies, while Iran is implementing selective Hormuz Strait transit restrictions targeting US and Israeli vessels.
sections.AI & Economy: Naver reported record Q2 revenue of 3.39 trillion won with AI-based advertising contributing over 60% of revenue growth, though operating profit declined 0.2% due to AI infrastructure investments. SK Hynix announced 54 trillion won investments in Yongin and Cheongju facilities to proactively address AI memory demand growth in the medium to long term. AI infrastructure expansion is driving significant power infrastructure investment growth, creating new corporate financing opportunities for global banks. LG AI Research Institute developed industry-specialized AI foundation models that outperformed Google and Alibaba in global institutional evaluations.
sections.Others: South Korea's financial regulator and Korea Exchange shortened the listing review period for single-stock leverage ETFs to 29 days, representing significant acceleration of approval processes. Bank of Korea has begun purchasing gold through ETFs in Q2 and plans to expand gold holdings as a reserve asset, joining China in building gold reserves during price declines. AI data centers face critical insurance coverage gaps as servers increasingly integrate lithium-ion batteries internally, creating chain reaction fire risks that traditional insurance policies cannot adequately cover. The US is investing $3 billion to reduce dependence on Chinese critical minerals and battery supply chains, with the Defense Department backing next-generation battery development initiatives.
